svg.title: Kaveon unified data intelligence architecture
svg.desc: One front door, two execution paths, one governed lake. Solid components are implemented on dev and verified on AKS; components marked Target name the gate that lands them. Assessed September 12, 2026.
svg.text: One front door · two execution paths · one governed lake
Solid: implemented on dev, verified on AKS. Marked TARGET: not yet — the gate is named.

g.text: Parquet · Delta · Iceberg on ADLS Gen2
Fabric SQL · Azure SQL · PostgreSQL · MySQL
Queried by the API; not federated by KaveonDB
NYC TLC taxi · OWID energy · WHO COVID

svg.text: Studio is the only front door · the API is the trusted control plane · the DLM is deterministic · KaveonDB executes over the lake

g.text: Chat · Catalog with SQL Lab as its query mode
Trusted proxy signs identity; the browser never
holds an API or Engine credential
Verifies the proxy, resolves identity and role
Two query planes: Engine bridge · external pool
Read-only SQL, result and statement bounds,
Route → resolve → clarify on a tie → answer
from precomputed context → else compile SQL
No hosted model. Same question, same answer.
Own parser → plan → stage DAG → schedule
COUNT(*) over 504M rows in 0.3 s from footers
Hash joins · TopN · windows · Arrow exchange
GROUP BY over 504M rows in ~20 s on 3 workers
Snapshot reads; conflicts surface as proofs
question → identity → DLM resolves metric, dimension, values
→ tie? ask · context? answer in ~0.1 s · else SQL
→ coordinator → workers → exact result, SQL shown
No model in the loop; 20–35 s live over 504M rows, instant after the DLM builds context
save a chart or dataset → validate → PostgreSQL + outbox
→ conditional head publication on ADLS → audit
Product records only. PostgreSQL stays authoritative until reconciliation and fencing evidence exist
Context in ~0.1 s, or live with the SQL shown
Built on datasets; published to the team
Every statement, its stages and its owner

svg.text: coordinator plus workers, elastic in Helm; verified on AKS with forced worker loss and concurrent load

g.text: Scale out for SQL; deterministic row-group and
Delta-file splits; retry to another worker
stages; hash, broadcast and round-robin partitioning
Columnar aggregates, joins, TopN, windows and
set operations over Arrow record batches
Memory limits and resource groups; spill for Sort,
TopN and hash aggregates; cancellation cleanup

svg.text: one lake for analytics and the product's records; PostgreSQL remains the record authority until the migration's evidence is complete

g.text: Parquet footers and pinned Delta snapshots drive
planning; identities are immutable per query
Retained snapshots and versioned ADLS objects today;
restore and rollback qualification are the gate

svg.text: Assessed against dev and Engine digest 4a165e94… on kaveon-test-aks, September 12, 2026. Measurements are recorded in HANDSHAKE.md with query IDs.
